author: potuz
content: The plan we had for 0x00 validators is that they need to send a BLS change if they want to preregister, otherwise they'll be automatically exited at the Q fork and eventually burnt if BLS becomes actually insecure

author: potuz
content: My preferred method would be to just move those funds to an inaccessible contract so that we can then later decide what to do with those funds

author: kevaundray
content: I'd like to avoid moving this into the social layer, ie someone needs to decide what happens with those funds and that seems like a social nightmare

author: kevaundray
content: It's extremely unfortunate for those who have lost their keys

author: potuz
content: the only way to avoid it to burn, which is already making a decision on those funds

author: kevaundray
content: Fair point on burning being a decision, that was my thinking

author: benjaminion
content: We have the addresses (in the chain history) from which the 0x00 deposits were made. We could move the funds to a contract that allows withdrawals to be made from those same addresses (Merkle airdrop claim style). They'd have to be gathered and inserted "by hand", but that might allow at least some to rescue their funds. If stakers deposited through a third-party, then they'd have to rely on them to do the right thing.
